name: fieldcast-ops-weather-intelligence
description: FieldCast Ops is a multi-tenant weather operations platform for working windows, incidents, and provider usage intelligence.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.build:api: npm run prisma:generate --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
